chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ibn Sinān and others, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding a woman who deflowered a slave-girl with her hand,
He said: “She is liable for the mahr, and the hadd punishment is to be administered to her.”

key_terms.بِيَدِهَا: with her hand, indicating the manner of the act
key_terms.ٱلْمَهْرُ: the dower or financial compensation due in this context
key_terms.ٱمْرَأَةٍ: a woman, the female subject of the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman deflowers a slave-girl with her hand?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who physically violated a slave-girl. It states that she must pay the mahr and that the hadd punishment is to be carried out upon her, indicating both financial liability and penal consequence in such a case.
